name: neurotriage-ai
description: Explainable Multimodal AI for Alzheimer's Risk Stratification & Clinical Triage

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

author: NeuroTriage AI Research Team
